findings.message: Section 1.1 coverage fails: 0 of 3 explanatory beats are information-bearing non-text, but at least 2 are required (two-thirds, rounding up). Typography beats count as text even when they carry a typography_only_exception.

explanatory typography beat 'beat-mechanism-as-bullets' carries no typography_only_exception rationale; a text-dominant beat must record its approved reason, and the exception never changes the coverage count

explanatory typography beat 'beat-comparison-as-text' carries no typography_only_exception rationale; a text-dominant beat must record its approved reason, and the exception never changes the coverage count

explanatory typography beat 'beat-total-as-text' carries no typography_only_exception rationale; a text-dominant beat must record its approved reason, and the exception never changes the coverage count
beat 'beat-mechanism-as-bullets' references scene 'bullet-card-01', which is not among the job's scene files, so its assertions cannot be resolved
beat 'beat-comparison-as-text' references scene 'bullet-card-02', which is not among the job's scene files, so its assertions cannot be resolved
beat 'beat-total-as-text' references scene 'bullet-card-03', which is not among the job's scene files, so its assertions cannot be resolved

reason_it_fails: The mechanism beat is replaced by a bullet-list text card and the other explanatory beats are text cards whose motion is decorative (a sweeping band and a sliding headline), so the storyboard fails the per-beat representation rules and the Section 1.1 rule that at least two-thirds of explanatory beats are information-bearing non-text.
